PAGE TITLE: FINANCIAL SECTION - FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, NOTES, AND REQUIRED SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION
18 NOTE 18 Public-Private Partnerships (CONTINUED)

KEY FACTS:
- NASA has entered into ESPCs and UESCs to procure energy savings and facility improvements.
- Under these contracts, NASA retains additional cost savings and receives title to installed goods, equipment, and improvements.
- ESPC and UESC contracts cannot exceed 25 years.
- ESPC expected life based on contract terms ranges from 16 to 24 years.
- UESC expected life based on contract terms ranges from 14 to 17 years.
- ESPC and UESC repayments can be funded on an annual basis under OMB Memorandum M-98-13 and M-12-21.
- ESPCs and UESCs can be terminated for convenience in part or in full, with NASA responsible for outstanding loan balances and early termination or payment fees.
